evidence: STRUCTURAL PASS, with integration measurement limitation. Workbook quality row 43 requires gate-first zeroing, no gate reward mass and a functional floor; its internal annotation says gate failures hard-zero quality terms. Frozen task tests/scoring.toml:1-11 sets render=constraints=0.0, weights only functional=.6/polish=.2/visual=.2, functional floor=.05. tests/tools/score.py:40-48 validates gates before scored_data can contribute, excludes gates from weighted sum, and requires functional strictly greater than .05; :83 returns 1 on a gate failure. tests/test.sh:212-227 removes stale scored output, runs gates, invokes score.py, exits on gate-status 1, then alone invokes scored. The policy, scorer and wrapper are byte-identical to the frozen template; SHA256 respectively 95f70d6e06aae5e765b2309d88c444aa36d4cd82763ea2212781b6a99311bbba, 13de2b3885967e22aa13ded3bf33c354e3e741e85be871612c04e996eef5c04e, bd68259276ca4b034654efc8a1723a4e702ed62dbe590af6201565f43eabe5aa, all matching the raw index. Both gate judge.toml files use binary/all_pass; criterion weight=1 is internal gate aggregation, not final reward mass. constraints/judge.toml:23-26 requires successful ordinary requisition plus pending-offer creation and independent Auditor readback, explicitly rejecting no-op/browser-only/static/requisition-only apps; its source hash 16e25fdcd5c40bc6c2e26e5bf3c21d912db4cf72d26aa542a59b146031e425f7 matches the index. Independent synthetic execution of the exact frozen score.py module (Python 3.12; _read_json supplied synthetic dimension results and Path.write_text intercepted in memory) produced: render=0 or constraints=0 with scored dimensions all 1 -> exit 1, reward 0, scored statuses skipped; gates-only -> reward 0; F=0/P=V=1 -> reward 0 despite weighted .4; F=.05/P=V=1 -> reward 0 despite weighted .43; F=.051/P=V=1 -> .4306; all 1 -> 1. These are policy-path measurements, not model scores. Plausible broken case: no-op successful POST cannot meet the independent saved-record gate. Hash-verified gate-witness/results.json:27-34 observes HTTP200 but all saved/readback flags false; golden :5-12 has successful creation/readback. Driver gate-witness.cjs:20-30 actually exercises UI and fresh browser context. SHA256 result fd8410bc91102874ef98edfdbacf19f7853687956e076acc684d36c565d9ec75 and driver 3c29a86eafb72caf23445c14850704878e5353fa2c9fb7ecf5903feaa0f197fc match current index. Conforming alternative considered: alternate routes, labels, money/date representations and layouts remain accepted by constraints/judge.toml:24-25; an all-success score is not falsely zeroed. Passing minimal creation while advanced approval fails is partial functionality, and its further credit belongs to scored criteria. No structural counterexample found. Risk remains true because available index explicitly reports no configured judge gate verdict or final reward: synthetic scorer execution and scripted UI observations cannot certify end-to-end configured gate judgment or reward behavior.
